note: Subscription fees the maintainer actually pays, plan by plan: with provider bills, the only real money in the observatory. A plan counts from its 'from' day (included) to its 'until' day (excluded). See README 'Money concepts'.

Claude Code.note: Pro for about a week before the upgrade, counted from 2026-09-24, the first day on record.

Codex CLI.note: ChatGPT Plus, no longer paid. Its cancellation date was not recorded, so it counts through April 2026, the month Codex CLI was last used.

Kimi Code.note: No longer paid. Its dates were not recorded, so it counts from the first day Kimi Code was used through September 2026, the month it was last used.

Claude Code.why: Claude Code deletes session transcripts after 30 days, and this history was gone before tokencur kept a ledger. The 2026-07-21 snapshot, which still had it, recorded $750.56 of Claude Code usage value (2026-06-04 to 2026-07-21).
